examined_elements.element: Origin-first retry dispatch and actual active poll
examined_elements.actual_source: rollback_retry dispatcher; evaluation_control.c:198-228; backend STEP BEGIN/poll/FINISH
examined_elements.ruling: Accepted. Current dispatcher tests origin AND pointer and otherwise reaches raw restore; this loses controlled lifecycle when host detaches handle. Dispatch origin unconditionally. Actual charge0 verifies active attempt and sticky stop without consumption; nonNULL alone proves neither. Current active accounting_error is EOVERFLOW, so host-facing inactive EINVAL-to-EBUSY mapping does not swallow existing positive accounting errors. Direct controlled helper must also poll before forward work.

examined_elements.element: Mandatory pending drain versus forward rollback recovery
examined_elements.actual_source: cleanup_ready pending-frame/recursive drain then rollback retry; quiescent host mutation callers
examined_elements.ruling: Accepted. Pending actual physical/credit/writer cleanup may precede active poll, but cannot scan/complete snapshots, restore content or allocate new image. Inactive/missing-control controlled record returns EBUSY before canonical host mutation, preserving original image/flags and selected target lifetime. Active real stopped attempt propagates its stop rather than silently applying raw restore. Existing raw origin/no-record/active nesting policy remains distinct.

examined_elements.element: Same-attempt backend recovery and explicit destruction/discard
examined_elements.ruling: Accepted with public-detach contract HOLD. Actual STEP/SNAPSHOT wrappers own BEGIN and FINISH, so selected recovery belongs after that BEGIN before baseline/evaluation under the same accounting. Explicit origin-aware inactive discard disposes original owners without canonical restoration; destruction must preserve object-before-frame ordering and true refusal. No private control or reset is authorized. Public control-detach compatibility must be independently bound before admission if its actual contract promises mutation availability or automatic recovery.

binding_requirements: A mandatory pending drain may terminalize only its actual consumed owner state. Do not reinterpret successful drain as entire rollback recovery complete, clear all entry flags or discard a valid recovery snapshot implicitly before active forward policy decides it.

After successful actual poll0, every forward lookup/entry scan/finality acknowledgment/lease operation remains charged and bounded. Repeated helper poll0 is a real stop check, not a BEGIN/reset; record-wide retained loop is not allowed pre-BEGIN.

Host mutation guards must honor EBUSY and controlled origin after control detachment. Configuration/reset required by recovery contract must remain possible between stopped attempts without allowing canonical input mutation; do not convert origin merely to make insert/remove pass.
Active-record nesting remains existing behavior only under genuine owner/attempt context; it is not permission for host reentrant mutation or disposal of active rollback/observer/publication.

Validate actual no-control detach API/session lifecycle semantics before admission, or return the named prerequisite. This accepted narrow guard is not a permanent supported-default exclusion, public API behavior waiver or full recovery claim.

Real attached-inactive/detached host call, active pre-cancel/new STEP recovery and physical-credit refusal fixtures must use production timing and original owners. No manually assigned recovery flags, synthetic BEGIN or control state mutation.

limits.resources: Read-only source and HOME receipt only; no builds/tests/index/CI/perf. Public-detach and all parent layout/admission HOLDs, full-task/latest-main/native Windows obligations and unwaived historical resource deviations remain.
